subject: Access evidence request — SSO/SAML + SCIM sync validation
messages:
From: Katie Liu <katie.liu@cardinalhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: security-team@cardinalhealth.com
Date: 2027-04-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cardinal Health — SSO/SCIM evidence request (next steps)

Hi Grace / Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The InfoSec team has a couple of follow-ups before we can move to procurement: they need artifact-level evidence for our SOC 2 review focusing on identity and access. Specifically:

- SAML assertion samples for typical user login flows (including an example containing the email/name/role attributes).
- SCIM sync delta showing user create/update/delete activity for the last 30 days (redacted PII ok).
- Role mapping spreadsheet showing how Redwood roles map to Cardinal Health groups and least-privilege rationale.

Can you confirm you can share these artifacts (or a secured link) and a short workback plan for delivery? We also need a contact for an ad-hoc walkthrough next week (45 minutes).

Appreciate it —
Katie Liu
Security Engineer, Cardinal Health
security@cardinalhealth.com

Attachment: request-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Katie Liu <katie.liu@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, PrIyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cardinal Health — SSO/SCIM evidence request (next steps)

Hi Katie —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide all three artifacts and walk through them in a 45-minute session. Proposed plan (high level):

1) Today — confirm scope and provide a secure Drive folder link with a placeholder and checklist.
2) 48 hours — deliver redacted SAML assertion samples and the role-mapping matrix (spreadsheet).
3) 72 hours — deliver a SCIM delta export (CSV) and a short narrative describing sync cadence and delta retention.
4) Next week — 45-minute walkthrough (we suggest Tue 4/20 or Wed 4/21, 10–11 PT).

I will coordinate internal artifact collection with Rishi (runtime/security) and Priyom (onboarding/SCIM owner). For the drive link we will redact sensitive PII and mark production vs. synthetic samples.

If that timeline works, I will upload an evidence pack and share a signed download link (Docs/ACLed Drive).

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Program Manager, Security & Evals — Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Attachments: none
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, PrIyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cardinal Health — SSO/SCIM evidence request (internal)

Grace / Priyom —

Quick notes on artifact intent and owners:

- SAML assertion samples: I will pull three assertion examples from our dev staging tenant (one success login, one missing attribute case, one MFA flow). These will be sanitized (emails replaced with example.com) and include the full assertion headers/attributes. Output: saml-assertion-samples.txt (text).

- SCIM delta export: Priyom, can you produce a delta CSV for the last 30 days scoped to the Cardinal tenant ID? We need create/update/delete rows and the associated timestamp and source (SCIM connector or manual). Redaction: replace usernames with hashed ids. Output: scim-delta-snapshot.csv (CSV).

- Role mapping matrix: Grace — we'll use the existing role->permission mapping from the onboarding runbook; I can add a short justification column for least-privilege decisions. Output: role-mapping-matrix.xlsx (Excel).

- Retention & logs note: I'll also prepare a one-page narrative describing assertion retention, where SAML logs are stored, and how we handle assertion replay protections.

I can take the lead on the walkthrough for the SAML/ops sections; Priyom should lead SCIM/connector discussion.

Rishi
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood

(On Wed, Apr 14, 2027 at 10:05 AM Grace O'Connor wrote:)
> Hi Katie —
> 
> Thanks for the clear list. We can provide all three artifacts and walk through them in a 45-minute session...
From: PrIyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T12:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cardinal Health — SCIM delta export (internal)

Rishi / Grace —

I pulled a scoped delta from the SCIM job for Cardinal tenant (job id scim-job-4471). Notes:

- The CSV will include: externalId, action (create/update/delete), timestamp, actor (connector/manual), and before/after attributes where applicable. We will hash user email addresses and remove phone numbers.
- Estimated size: ~4200 rows for the 30-day window. I will compress and add a short readme describing the column mapping.
- ETA: I can upload the redacted CSV to the drive link by 16:00 PT today.

I also recommend we include a short sample of the SCIM PATCH payload for one update case so the reviewer can see attribute mappings in context.

Priyom
Onboarding Engineer, Redwood

Attachment: scim-extract-readme.txt (text/plain)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Katie Liu <katie.liu@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, PrIyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Michael Barnes <michael.barnes@cardinalhealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cardinal Health — SSO/SCIM evidence request (deliverables & walkthrough)

Katie / Michael —

Per our plan above, we've uploaded an initial evidence pack to a secured Drive folder and listed the delivered artifacts below. Please note all PII is redacted or hashed; filenames and summaries are attached.

Drive link (restricted): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4dEviw_example

Delivered artifacts:
- saml-assertion-samples.txt (three sanitized assertion examples + short explanation)
- scim-delta-snapshot.csv.gz (30-day delta, hashed emails, readme included)
- role-mapping-matrix.xlsx (role->group mapping + least-privilege rationale column)
- access-proof-checklist.pdf (checklist mapping items to SOC 2 control criteria)

Walkthrough availability: we can do Tue 2027-04-20 10:00–10:45 PT. Please confirm which time works or propose alternatives. For the walkthrough: Rishi will cover SAML/log retention and assertion protections; Priyom will cover SCIM delta generation and connector behavior; I will cover role mapping and the rationale.

If you need any additional artifacts (e.g., full SAML log extracts or a signed audit stamp), let me know and we can scope next steps.

Best regards,
Grace O'Connor
Program Manager, Security & Evals — Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

Attachments: saml-assertion-samples.txt (text/plain), scim-delta-snapshot.csv.gz (text/csv), role-mapping-matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), access-proof-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)
